plan: To preserve capital, we will sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, METU) to zero.
SPY will be trimmed to 20% to meet the single-name concentration mandate.
We will add SNOW to 10% as a top-quality name, aligning with the conservative approach.
This plan prioritizes capital preservation and reduces overall portfolio risk.
A significant cash buffer will be maintained.
conservative.read: This conservative plan targets a modest ~1.5% per month, focusing on capital preservation. It significantly reduces risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and lowering concentration. Expect lower drawdowns but also limited upside potential.

plan: We will trim leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, METU) to reduce overall leverage.
SPY will be trimmed to 25% to meet the single-name concentration mandate.
SNOW will be added to 4% to blend quality tech into the portfolio.
CRWD will be added to 10% to lean into a strong performer.
This plan balances risk and growth, maintaining a moderate cash buffer.
balanced.read: This balanced plan aims for ~2.5% per month, prioritizing risk-first growth. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while blending broad index with quality tech. Expect moderate drawdowns and growth potential.

plan: We will add to leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, METU) to increase exposure to high-growth sectors.
SPY will be trimmed to 15% to allow for greater concentration in high-potential assets.
SNOW will be bought to 6% as a high-scoring scanner setup.
CRWD will be added to 10% to press into a strong performer.
This plan uses leverage and concentration for stretch growth, with strict stops.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4% per month, aiming for stretch growth. It leans into leveraged ETFs and concentrates in high-scoring setups. Be aware this raises both upside and drawdown potential significantly; leveraged ETFs decay daily, and losses can be substantial if stops are not strictly adhered to.

plan: To prioritize income, we will sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, METU) to zero.
High-beta single names like CRWD and SNOW will also be sold to zero.
SPY will be trimmed to 20% to shift focus towards income-generating assets.
QQQI will be significantly increased to 30% for steady monthly distributions.
This plan aims for low drawdown and reliable income over growth.
income.read: This income plan targets ~1% per month, focusing on parking cash for yield. It rotates into income/covered-call ETFs and broad index, cutting leverage and high-beta names. While prioritizing low drawdown and reliable income, distributions are variable, and NAV can still fall in a selloff; this is not a savings account.
